name: Searing Wave

source.title: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

text:
Aspect fire

Activate 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

---

Effect You allow a portion of the fire magic housed in your relic to escape in a direction of your choice. You deal 1d10 fire damage for every 2 levels of the relic to all creatures in a 30-foot cone (basic Reflex save). You can't use Searing Wave again for 1d4 rounds.
